policy.note: Camera serves who is waiting, leaving, listening, choosing — not tourism.

attic.framing: close domestic framing with glimpses downward toward the sister
attic.movement: small, human; eyeline dips to stairs/floor
must_not: shock cut to sister face as scare

archive.framing: slow lateral movement, frames within frames, partial faces

steam.framing: low human perspective with machinery above and around workers
steam.movement: grounded track; height stays with bodies
must_not: crane over factory for spectacle only

electric.framing: wider compositions showing relief and absence together

digital.framing: reflections and flattened screens that make Oino watch herself
digital.movement: locked or micro push into glass

zone.framing: patient movement, uncertain depth, empty space after people leave

table.framing: restrained two-shots and close-ups that protect performance

return.framing: opening angles repeated with changed behaviour
return.movement: echo attic/door angles; behaviour carries the change
must_not: new spectacle language that abandons the open

title_card.framing: still frame, no decorative trailer motion

shots.focus_target: Oino eyeline toward downstairs / attic door edge
shots.emotional_purpose: Invitation arrives; domestic closeness with a glimpse toward the sister she will refuse.

shots.focus_target: Oino's hands on playback / unfinished tape
shots.emotional_purpose: Need crystallizes in the unfinished melody — intimate, not spectacular.

shots.focus_target: box label OINO; partial hand entering frame
shots.emotional_purpose: Name inheritance as object — discovery without classroom diagram.

shots.focus_target: damaged family-line document; partial faces at edge
shots.emotional_purpose: Lineage as worn paper — artistic adaptation, not universal claim.

shots.focus_target: hands and cloth; machinery soft above
shots.emotional_purpose: Care as ordinary labour — watcher still able to mend.

shots.hero_label: ancestor ignoring the call to dinner
shots.focus_target: ancestor adjusting camera; dinner call off-screen
shots.emotional_purpose: Embarrassing ordinary refusal — implication, not sermon.

shots.focus_target: workers at threshold; gate/machinery towering
shots.emotional_purpose: Doorway becomes factory gate — history through bodies, not labels.

shots.hero_label: electricity returning time to a household
shots.focus_target: household room — light returns; empty chair / absence held in same frame
shots.emotional_purpose: Benefit and cost together: relief of light, absence still present.

shots.focus_target: living speaker and device; face and interface share frame
shots.emotional_purpose: Care through technology — not memorial ghost; living person uses the tool.

shots.focus_target: Oino's reflection in screen / black glass watching herself
shots.emotional_purpose: She becomes watcher of her own controlled archive — shadow foreshadow without scare.

shots.focus_target: distant table through uncertain depth; Oino mid-passage
shots.emotional_purpose: Destination appears before arrival — ordinary sacred ahead; Zone unexplained.

shots.hero_label: father and Oino in the warm two-shot
shots.focus_target: father and Oino sharing table eyeline
shots.emotional_purpose: Genuine comfort — why she stays; protect performance.

shots.hero_label: Oino's hand on the reset control
shots.focus_target: Oino's hand on PROP_PlaybackControl
shots.emotional_purpose: Shadow as merciful grip — dread from control, not horror light.

shots.focus_target: PROP_ReflectiveSurface_Sister — sister, bowls, untouched place
shots.emotional_purpose: Cost already present — loneliness in progress, not later warning.

shots.focus_target: fingers lifting from control; want still on face
shots.emotional_purpose: Holy-fool hinge — ordinary costly release.

shots.focus_target: hands receiving bowl beside sister
shots.emotional_purpose: Nourishment accepted; presence without demanding forgiveness.

shots.focus_target: sister's tapping hand / face — her own rhythm
shots.emotional_purpose: Real creative contribution — living variation, not symbolic child.

shots.focus_target: open doorway; women may be edge or already gone
shots.emotional_purpose: Final story image — invitation kept open (answers closed attic).

shots.focus_target: title card type — One Of Gods Fools
shots.emotional_purpose: Final film image — still; no trailer motion.

shots.focus_target: attic door closing; hand on latch
shots.emotional_purpose: Refusal completed — doorway excludes sister.

shots.focus_target: empty passage after Oino leaves frame
shots.emotional_purpose: Patient empty space — nature unresolved.

shots.focus_target: father standing and leaving; Oino listening
shots.emotional_purpose: He finishes and goes — life beyond her desire.
